entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim: a mysterious realm of lakes and pine forests where reality is mutable.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane containing the ten realms, including Littjara.

entities.name: Shapeshifters
entities.description: Beings who dwell in Littjara and can pass easily out of it into the Cosmos.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The ancient elven gods who created the realm that would become Littjara.

entities.name: Pentafjord Lake
entities.description: A hand-shaped enormous lake in Littjara where shapeshifters go to pass away.

events.summary: The Einir create the realm that would become Littjara, marking the land indelibly.
events.quote: When the Einir , the ancient elven gods , created the realm that would become Littjara, their interference marked the land indelibly.

events.summary: At the end of their lives all shapeshifters return to Pentafjord Lake and slip beneath its surface to die.
events.quote: At the end of their lives, all shapeshifters are drawn to return to Littjara

relations.quote: Littjara is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim
